text:
sana: Quick sync — proposing a phased shipping approach for the model-preference toggle customers asked for. want to avoid big blast radius, keep opt-in cohorts and an automatic shutter if perf regresses. thoughts?

jamie: +1 on cohorts. can we make the first cohort invite-only (support + SEs) before opening to a percent sample?

sana: yup — plan is: invite-only alpha (10 customers), then 1% public, then 10%, then ramp to all. each step gated on latency, p95 error, and quality A/B metric.

leo: what are the exact gating numbers? need them to wire alerts and the circuit-breaker.

sana: proposed gates — latency p95 <= 150ms, token error rate < 0.1%, quality regression (A-B) no worse than -1.5% on our intent accuracy eval. if any breach -> auto-shutter and fallback to model_v1.

ethan: curious about telemetry. we should tag requests with cohort_id and variant so downstream can slice. also preserve user attribution for billing.

maria: launch criteria checklist draft:
- alpha validated by 2 customers
- metrics wiring in console and alerts in pagerduty
- canary A/B test running for 48h with >5k samples
- docs + opt-out UI in the console
- kill-switch and manual shutter documented + tested

pm-bot: checklist created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-pref-shipping (add your owners) :white_check_mark:

jamie: small config snippet for flags I sketched:
```yaml
feature_flag: model_pref_v2
cohorts:
  - name: invite-alpha
    pct: 0
    allowlist: ["acct-123", "acct-456"]
  - name: sample-1pct
    pct: 1
  - name: sample-10pct
    pct: 10
fallback: model_v1
auto_shutter: true
shutter_thresholds:
  latency_p95_ms: 150
  error_rate_pct: 0.1
  quality_drop_pct: 1.5
```

leo: perfect. I'll add metric alarms and a circuit-breaker that flips the flag via the admin API. please confirm the admin path.

sana: admin API will be /admin/flags/model_pref_v2/override. deploy-bot will also post an automated shutter if thresholds breached during public sampling.

deploy-bot: NOTE: automated shutter will post to #incidents and call the oncall channel if triggered.

ethan: one more ask — for canary A/B we should run paired evals (same prompts) to avoid sampling bias. plan to capture a small debug payload for failed comparisons.

maria: agree. add an opt-in debug-log flag that includes prompt_hash and normalized_response_diff. only enabled for alpha and 1% cohorts.

sana: timeline proposal: alpha next Tue, 1% the following Wed (if gates pass), 10% two weeks after. will book a final gating review on Monday. anyone blocking?

jamie: blockers: need SE invites list and billing tagging plan. assigned to me.

leo: I'll have alarms and circuit-breaker ready by Friday.

maria: I'll finish docs + UI text by Monday.

sana: awesome — thanks all. ping me in thread if anything changes. :rocket:
